sourceCriteria.exactText: Every swipe the runner performs on Android uses one gesture engine with the same timing model, so a flow author gets the same travel, the same fling behaviour and the same `distance:`/`duration:` semantics whether the swipe targets an element, a screen direction, or explicit `start:`/`end:` points. `engine: adb` stays as the explicit opt-in to `input swipe`.

Route direction and point swipes through the same held-drag path as element swipes (start point = screen point or `start:`), keep `engine: adb` as the escape hatch, and extend the L07 tests to the three forms. Schedule: round 4 unless the round-3 coverage pass turns a `B3-L` row red on it.

**Step 7: Device acceptance.** On owned software and GPU AVDs, run the four L51 forms and retain before/after app-only hierarchy frames; run favorite removal 5/5 on each; run bare stopApp 3/3 plus an intentionally ineffective fake-shell unit case. Validate the runner’s existing `--device` and its existing `--udid` alias, and CLI’s existing target flags; preserve existing aliases and do not add unsupported `--serial`. In `SimulatorCommandTests`, feed a UDID-shaped but malformed value to the existing `SimulatorUDID.validate` path and require its current usage error. Do not add `--serial` and keep an unknown-flag parsing control. Run the same assertion from `/tmp` and its `/private/tmp` spelling.

Once a step fails, the failure artefacts (screenshot, hierarchy, logcat tail) are captured within ~2 s on the default software-rendered AVD at host load below 15, so a crash flow's wall time is the app's cold start plus a few seconds.

Capture screenshot, hierarchy and logcat concurrently; take the screenshot through the UIAutomator2 server (`GET /screenshot`, PNG over the existing socket) instead of `adb screencap` + pull when the server is alive; bound each capture by a short deadline and record a note instead of blocking the report. Schedule: round 4 unless a `B3`/`N3` row fails on it.

**Step 2: Write failing L61 tests.** Extend `pkg/executor/duration_consistency_test.go` around `FlowRunner.captureArtifacts`: use package-private context-aware screenshot, hierarchy and log-tail fakes where one waits on `ctx.Done()`. Assert all three collectors start concurrently, successful bytes survive, every blocked fake observes cancellation and exits, and the whole call returns in at most 2 seconds plus a 250 ms scheduling allowance. Repeat 25 failed captures and assert goroutine/resource counts return to the test's bounded baseline. Add reciprocal blocked-hierarchy and blocked-log-tail cases and the artifact paths/timeout-note JSON round-trip beside `pkg/report/flow.go`.

**Step 7: Device acceptance.** On owned `fix4-1-android` below host load 15, run the exact crash flow five times. No launch succeeds after a prior matching fatal; fatal-to-failure remains within the L64 two-second bound. Record artifact start/end timestamps and prove failure capture completes within the L61 bound with no collector child left afterward. Run the healthy launch control and a post-return-crash control separately; the latter must not retroactively fail a launch that already returned.
